userAgent.description:
User-Agent HTTP header for MediaWiki API requests
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/User-Agent

Config.description: Config represents the configuration for PatrolBot.

api.description:
API version URL, e.g. https://discord.com/api/v10
See: https://discord.com/developers/docs/reference#api-versioning

Discord.description: Discord represents the Discord bot configuration.

Duration.description: Duration represents a span of time expressed in hours, days, or weeks.

windows.description: Durations of time before changes reach $wgRCMaxAge and expire from Special:RecentChanges.

PatrolExpiring.description: PatrolExpiring represents the configuration for the github.com/iocalebs/patrolbot/internal/report/data.PatrolExpiring data source.

ReportData.description: ReportData represents the configuration for the data sources used for a report type.

template.description: File name of the template to use for the report

channelID.description: Discord channel to post the report to

data.description: Data to use in the report

ReportType.description: ReportType represents the configuration for a specific report type.

templateDir.description: Path to directory containing report templates

types.description: Defines the types of reports that can be generated using the `report` command

Reports.description: Reports represents the configuration for generating reports.

site.description: MediaWiki site information that PatrolBot needs to be aware of.

auth.description:
Authentication credentials for the MediaWiki API
See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Login

client.description: Configuration for the HTTP client used for MediaWiki API requests.

Wiki.description: Wiki represents the configuration for a particular MediaWiki instance.

WikiAuth.description: WikiAuth represents the configuration for the bot's MediaWiki API login credentials.

timeout.description:
Request timeout as a string, e.g. "2s" or "500ms"
A timeout of zero means no timeout

from.description:
From HTTP header for API requests
https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Headers/From

WikiClient.description: WikiClient represents configuration for the HTTP client used for MediaWiki API requests.

articlePath.description:
Wiki article path without /$1 ending - typically "/wiki"
See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:$wgArticlePath

rcMaxAgeDays.description:
The wiki's recent changes retention period in days
See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:$wgRCMaxAge

rcLinkLimit.description:
Maximum results that can be shown in the wikis' Special:RecentChanges
See https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Manual:$wgRCLinkLimits

WikiSite.description: WikiSite represents MediaWiki instance configuration (namely $wg variables) that PatrolBot needs to be aware of.
